report.answer: The moving orange ball is a simple pendulum on a string. It swings with a small-angle period of ~1.74 s for a ~0.75 m length, giving g ~9.9 m/s² consistent with Earth gravity, with very little damping (Q ~45). The cyan pendulum law overlays the yellow centres to <0.2 px.
assumptions: ball diameter 0.24 +/-0.02 m at same depth as motion

forks.label: no air
forks.why: remove weak damping to see ideal undamped pendulum

forks.label: Moon gravity
forks.why: same length on Moon would swing ~2.5x slower, period ~4.3 s

forks.label: Jupiter gravity
forks.why: stronger pull shortens period to ~1.1 s
